description: Aider-polyglot style (JavaScript): implement an INI parser from a stub and an instructions file - inline comments only after whitespace, quoted values with escapes and trailing comments, continuation lines that stop at blank or comment lines, merged sections, last-duplicate-wins and errors carrying the physical line number. The node:test suite is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
